insert into RENT_CTRT ( /* kr.or.ddit.domain.central.rentCtrt.mapper.IRentCtrtMapper.insertRentCtrt */ RENT_CTRT_NO , USER_NO , REG_DT , CTRT_STTS_CD , RENT_LSTG_NO , DPST_AMT , MTHLY_RENT_AMT , SBMSN_DOC_NO , MVIN_DT )
select #{map.rentCtrtNo} , A.USER_NO , sysdate , 'PENDING' , R.RENT_LSTG_NO , R.DPST_AMT , R.MTHLY_RENT_AMT , DOC.SBMSN_DOC_NO , ANN.MVIN_PRD_DT from APLCT A inner join APT_HO_TY HT on(A.HO_TY_NO = HT.HO_TY_NO) inner join APT_DETAIL H on(HT.HO_TY_NO = H.HO_TY_NO) inner join RENT_LISTING R on(H.HO_NO = R.HO_NO) inner join SBMSN_DOC DOC on(DOC.APLCT_NO = A.APLCT_NO) inner join CENTER_ANN_BOARD_POST ANN on(A.ANN_NO = ANN.ANN_NO) where A.APLCT_NO = #{map.aplctNo} and ROWNUM = 1

insert into CTRT_MGR ( CTRT_MGR_NO , USER_NO , MGR_ASGN_DT , CHG_YN , RENT_CTRT_NO )
select SEQ_CTRT_MGR.nextval , #{manager} , sysdate , 'N' , #{map.rentCtrtNo} from DUAL
